editorial.blurb: Woo Chon is a genuine Korean BBQ destination where oak charcoal grilling and genuinely attentive family-owned hospitality make every visit memorable.
editorial.insiderTip: Call ahead to confirm hours before visiting, and ask your server about complimentary side dish refills—the charcoal-grilled marinated chicken and beef short ribs are worth the trip.
signatureDishes: Kimchi stew with tofu and pork
